about: Hand-maintained list of the third-party parts in the Windows installer and of what the app downloads later.
scripts/generate-third-party-notices.js turns it and package-lock.json into THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md (npm run notices).
scripts/after-pack-win.js fails a Windows build when a file in resources/bin matches no files glob below.
files: globs relative to the packaged resources folder, matched without regard to case. ../ is the install folder; app.asar/... names a path inside the archive.
licenseText: a path under licenses/, or the licence text itself; an array holds several. licenseFiles records where each licenses/ file came from.
name, version, copyright and note land in Markdown as written, so put names containing * or _ in backticks.
